item.title: Two arrested after police find more than 110 pounds of meth in trunk of car
item.description: Two people have been arrested after law enforcement discovered approximately 114 pounds of methamphetamine and other drugs in the trunk of their car.

item.title: House committee advances bill limiting number of official city flags
item.description: A bill that would restrict cities, municipalities, counties, or political subdivisions from flying more than one official flag in certain areas advanced to the Utah house on Friday.

item.title: Southbound State Street reopened after crash with oil spill caused road closure
item.description: The road is closed on southbound State Street near 2100 South.

item.title: Salt Lake City delegation meets in sister city Torino, Italy to celebrate anniversary of 2006 Winter Games
item.description: A delegation from Salt Lake City and Utah 2034 visited SLC's sister city Torino, Italy to celebrate the 20th anniversary of the 2006 Torino Winter Games.

item.title: WATCH: Footage of 3.5 magnitude earthquake that hit Wasatch Front
item.description: A 3.5 magnitude earthquake hit northwest of West Valley City and many people across the Wasatch Front felt it. ABC4 acquired video footage of the earthquake.

item.title: Utah residents share reactions moments after 3.5 magnitude earthquake shakes Wasatch Front
item.description: Utah residents are sharing their reactions moments after a 3.5 magnitude earthquake struck West Valley City on Friday evening.

item.title: Utah residents host 'read-in' to protest book ban legislation
item.description: On Friday, dozens of individuals attended a demonstration at the Utah State Capitol to protest a bill that would limit "sensitive" teaching materials.

item.title: 'It builds confidence in them': Washington County high school students build house featured in Parade of Homes
item.description: Today is the opening day for the St. George area Parade of Homes, but one home stands out from the rest. We are not talking about a walk-in pantry, an indoor basketball court, or a resort style pool, but one home was built by high school students in Washington County.

item.title: Southern Utah rancher speaks out after pollution reportedly kills livestock
item.description: A Southern Utah rancher is speaking out after he says trash pollution and waste dumps have killed off cattle in the area.

item.title: Wasatch County GOP chair released on bail after being accused of waterboarding 16-year-old
item.description: The Wasatch County Republican Party Chair who was accused of waterboarding his 16-year-old relative has been released on bail.
